notes.title: Plague update and donation to fight Covid
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Villains!

Every victim stays at home. No one to rob, no one to kill, no fun. Our evil minions were sad...
So we needed to do something! [h3] That's why our team has decided to [b]donate all of Wild Factor's May 2020 profits[/b] from the sale of Machiavillain to [b]organizations fighting Covid[/b]![/h3]

And with that, [h3][b]the plague update:[/b][/h3]
We added the survival kit during this difficult time:

Toilet paper.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27993755/d07e39e775f7bcddfad3b9ef4f5f4db4e949b781.png[/img]
Always have one at hand when you cut yourself while shaving.

Medical mask
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27993755/9b1f0d67ecc1af32d1356ffc8d9514223457db9b.png[/img]
Looks cool on you when you do evil stuff.

Hand sanitizer
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27993755/86098ffcf9bc1f8cbdacce23b9cdd90dda190d00.png[/img]

And:
- The virus event has been deactivated.
- You can get food poisoning now if you eat food that went bad. Keep your human flesh fresh!

Bug fix:
- Fix enemy spam to map border sometimes blocked.
- Fix pathway can no longer replace the regular floor (unless you demolish it first).
- Fix dig rock not working on a particular rock position.
- Fix food go bad level transfer during a split.
- Fix load save bug (electricity build on map border).
- Fix load save bug (task not init).


If you find any bug, please send us a message with the ingame feedback button on the lower right of the screen. Don't forget to fill at least the title. Thanks!

Stay safe and enjoy Machiavillain at home :)

notes.title: Electrocution Update ! (+ 50%off for a limited time)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/2d1c529f4f30c6faa83dd12a7cf4a8fee005d989.jpg[/img]

Hello fellow Villains,

[b]Electrocution update[/b] is here!
[url=https://youtu.be/VSGmADqluVo]Update Trailer[/url]

[b]Electric Features [/b]

- The impressive Finger of Evil! A machine that gives you the power to generate lightning! You can zap victims, heroes or even your own minion to make them go faster.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/8e1adef179804d5b8226322caa93f00298c3973b.jpg[/img]


- Batteries, wood generators, treadmill generators, wires.
- Tesla coils to electrocute your enemies.
- Alarm and Presence sensors (to activate/deactivate alarm). 
- Lightning rod (to get electricity from thunder and protect your mansion)
- Mobile phone jammer. Don't let your victim call for help!
- Electric door (closed when powered by electricity).
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/32c6d487b2587cb8e9e9a2977b0aadd21d1dea42.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/37747d7df2a50f67cbd9b324f6980a02493ebe1a.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/66046a0dd9c0685a2fb3a723906d9de84d680e33.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/cd366d336c9a9738797379f12cc24a38fb74eb8d.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/adc004c9915097ece0d6c32ac69bb792227b344c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/97c2afd78ff9fa6e9e1eb25236eeb986c30db8a0.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/bc8c87c94c92efe4d69390323765cb18706ce894.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/50b110335f8b312972365d2e9ead20be1c6e57bc.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/3976996d224b2cb766c425bd99056dfa739d3002.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/ab38f090c20084d1c6ff701bf016589211348d48.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/fa7ef81b32d6ff604e669cc749e89fe5aa5867b2.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/f2d515f8814095542cd78a62d51e8488ee4bfabe.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/d5d0023aa9e8cd16d6a17235544af1d5dc43cd2d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/b5a66b9051186757f7ef5b42ead0979721636f03.png[/img][/url]


- Some furniture now need electricity. Candles need to be lit by your minion.
- Reduce the cost of things that need electricity.

[b]New Minion[/b]

- Succubus: Sucks the life out of your enemies.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/88248ee725ce1f9c3521699921cfd3a5093366bf.jpg[/img]

[b]Customisations[/b]: 

- Custom map: configure a map to your will.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/40a8e258d05df91d2c6cebb163ddb80be29f3ec4.jpg[/img]

- Difficulty level: normal, hard very hard, so you can play casual, or scream all the way.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/593aa9f3fdf02d9290ec3bc90a07b41a8323aab6.jpg[/img]

[b]Environment[/b]

- You can dig graves to get ancient artefacts or wake up more-or-less friendly monsters!
- Dead monsters leave a grave behind.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/9a9da36bbe27e0c23c5c402f74ef88b01b3c234f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/5db2963d5cdf8830e0d137fbc615b43dedd91870.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Beta Build 2.0 on beta branch (Electricity update preview)
notes.notes:
Hi fellow villains,

[b]v2.0 beta branch[/b] is up (select "[b]development[/b]" branch in steam game property)
Beta branch with a preview of the coming ELECTRICITY feature.
We've uploaded a new build than those who get access earlier from the steam forum link with bug fixes from your feedback, not yet listed here.

Guide to play a steam beta:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/290080/discussions/4/365163686066965426/

[b]DISCLAIMER[/b]: This has not been fully tested or polish. It's rough around the edge :)
[b]Give us your feedback[/b], so we can fix it before the official update release.


Feature 
- Batteries, wood generators, treadmill generators, wires.
- Alarm and Presence sensors (to activate/deactivate alarm). 
- Lightning rod. (to get electricity from thunder and protect your mansion)
- Mobile phone jammer. 
- Electric door (close when powered by electricity). 
- The impressive finger of evil!. A machine that gives you the power to generate lightning! You can zap victims, heroes or even your own minion to make them go faster.
- Some furniture now needs electricity. Candle needs to be light by your minion.
- Reduce the cost of things that need electricity.
- Custom map, configure a map to your will.
- Difficulty level, normal, hard very hard, so you can play casual, or scream all way.

Improvements 
- Click on an item in the inventory select it and focus on it (finding weapon).
- Reduce game size (-80 mo download size).
- improved sound spatialization.
- Be able to reorder crafting queue.
- Be able to configure your minion IA (attack, defend, neutral)
- Be able to change sleep and fedd priorities.

Bugs fixed 
- Bug: Achievement: killing a hero are not count correctly
ACHIEVEMENT_KILL_HEROES_LEVEL1.
- Bug Event, give brain, don’t come back. 
- hypnotized people should still be able to be attacked by minions.
- Bug: dogs seem to be ignoring the fire hydrant Medium done Alexandre.
- Bug: if you have 2 rows of minion portraits, their portraits will cover the popup notifications on the screen.
- Bug: if you have enough minions to scroll down in the job board, the lowest minion is difficult to see coz they're covered by the menu graphics.
- Bug: heroes seem to have stopped spawning when I reached high suspicion. it says "villagers are aware of my murderous activities!" but no angry village mob is showing up, no heroes are showing up either. 
- Bug: dr. frankenstein heal dart doesn't activate after successfully using it a few times. even after waiting a few days to recover stamina. dart still doesn't activate. dr. frankenstein just humps the targeted minion but nothing happens.

hypnotized minions (ie : hypnotized by the vampire in vacation event) are taken out of roster, but - you can "hire" them again to stop the hypnosis, although they give everyone else the "saw a minion die" loyalty debuff.
- I'm still not getting the "kill virgin last" bonus, I only get the reward for "kill them when alone" bonus.
- Victims could see twice a trap from other room and get stuck.
- Dog barking sound doesn't stop.
- Bug TV bad cooldown

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/f4b023825dd22549eaabdb21ba5a693bd7f2badd.gif[/img]

notes.title: Bug Patch #5
notes.notes:
Dear fellow Villains,
the electricity is not yet ready, but we made a lot of bug fixes and some improvement based on your feedback :)
So we thought it would be nice to release it before the next content update.

[h1]Improvement:[/h1]
- Buttons to demolish/cancel action (with shortcut).
- Autosave limit the quantity and frequency.
- Add [select all] button.
- Increase gold storage capacity from 500 to 700 Increase Wood normal/evil capacity from 600 to 800.
- Every monster can get a weapon and to compensate psychopath cooldown for weapon is divided in half.
- Esc key bring the setting menu.
- Button to start/stop tasks (Fight/working mod) on individual monster.
- New event manager (virus events shouldn't be close).
- Post office closing during the night (your minion won't bring letter and cross a victim path).
- Clown reworks (don't scare victims).

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
- Victims enter map with bleeding status.
- Victims appears at the bottom left corner after a load.
- Victims not arriving after load.
- Day counter blocked after a load.
- Some mobs respawn after a load.
- Monsters don't bring letters to storage.
- A Push trap placed next to a rotatable wall trap will not push the human when he passed the rotatable wall.
- Mad scientist Achievement unlocks retro compatibility old save.
- Spam email counter is displayed in reverse.
- Rat of the event mystical chest fight each other.
- Dogs can use phones.
- Victims get costume cook after a load.
- Time /day stops increasing.
- Dog increase suspicion when they leave the map.
- Esc key bug on fight skill points distribution screen.
- Hypnotize victim don't phone and are not scared.
- Minion's face doesn't change after recruiting it.
- Music change when food merchants.
- Body part going through walls (and may scare victims).
- Weapons added back to the enemy after a load.
- Hero doesn't drop weapons.
- Victim sometimes sees minions through the walls.
- Can't attack when the target is on a bed.
- Poison of the gaz master doesn't work on victims.
- Merchant sound on arrival can't be heard from far.
- Feedback messages when victims are scared overlay when there is more than one.

Thank you so much for your support, feedback and patience! 
Alex & Zimra

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/f7cb5d3404d15ee4658a95964343e06f8d5588f9.png[/img]

notes.title: Bug Patch #4
notes.notes:
Dear fellow Villains,

Again we want to thank you for continues support. It really is amazing to see that so many of you enjoy the game so much on a daily basis!

We do our best to improve the game every day. We have a new update for you that addresses the following issues:

- Save/Load bugs: 93% fixed.
- Lab XP gain doesn't work when monster wears glasses.
- Rotating walls work on non attracted victims.
- Monsters with increased health from lab return to default health after sleeping in special bed.
- Turret just shoots sometimes at nothing.
- Achievements "all research done" and "100 days "not always trigger.
- Turret not always reloading.
- Some Heroes Attack victims.
- Dogs have wrong sound when die.
- Sarcophagus increases the max hp but shows a -1hp icon.
- Fire Hydrant can be placed on the road.
- Saving a file and name it with something with " K " it will activate fight stance.
- Fire can't be extinguished after a tv as been burned.

Besides this, we have some exciting news for you! For the next big patch, that will be released end of july, we have planned a major content update that is all about electricity. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993755/634d986f767e9d62f82f89d9ab9e01efd3284b07.png[/img]
We will post more details about that next week.

We said this before, but if you find a bug, we would appreciate it if you could click on "Send Feedback" (bottom right) and add a short description. It will send us useful game data and it will help us fix them, thank you!

As always, we thank you so much for your support, feedback and patience!  

Alex & Zimra

notes.title: Bug Patch #3
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Villains,


Thank you for your support! 
It's amazing to see the mansions you come up with!

Here is a new patch including:

Save/Load bugs: 90% fixed 
Monster not using the table
All monsters idle when 1 room is fully enclosed
1 head appearing in 3 fridge items slot, blocking monster for working
Victims escaping without entering a room that has no other door
Victim not entering when fancy door is replaced by regular door 
After loading victims group don't follow the leader and are stuck
Victims stuck in the doorframe between room (when low frame rate)
Victims becoming transparent when scared + starving after load
Victims using hidden door when first room only has hidden door and entry door
Removing lamp after a load = victims act as if light still here (not scared)

We also started balancing the advanced furnitures that require metal (metal, plates, cogs) following your feedbacks. 

We are working on the next bug fixes update for the 22nd.
There might be another one after if needed.
But after that we will be able to focus on adding content and features (while still fixing eventual minor bugs). We'll start discussing it with you on the Steam forum after the next patch. 


As usual, if you find a bug, we would appreciate it if you could click on "Send Feedback" (bottom right) and add a short description. It will send us useful game data and it will help us fix them, thank you! 


Thank you for your patience and support, 
Alex & Zimra

notes.title: Machiavillain will release its terrors upon the world on May 16, 2018
notes.notes:
Hello Villains,
We are excited to announce that MachiaVillains, the evil mansion management and strategy game, will release its terrors upon the world on [b]May 16, 2018[/b], on Windows PC, Mac and Linux for $19.99.

[b]You can take a Look at the [url=https://youtu.be/Nq5a7TRrpgM] MachiaVillain Announcement Trailer[/url][/b].
